checkedAlternates.risk: Carbon makes up ~45% of plant dry biomass.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Carbon is a non-mineral element absorbed from atmospheric CO2 (group-1), not a soil-applied primary NPK fertilizer (group-3).

checkedAlternates.resolution: Magnesium is a secondary macronutrient needed in gram-per-kg quantities (group-2), whereas iron is a trace micronutrient (group-4).
